summary: Service-runner blocked by 403: duplicated SCIM 'affiliation' attribute causing RBAC lookup mismatch
description:
Issue summary:
A scheduled service-runner (internal CI deploy bot) suddenly started receiving 403 responses from the internal-ops API when performing role-assume calls via SSO. The failure began after the nightly SCIM sync window. The identity token appears valid but RBAC lookup fails because the user's 'affiliation' attribute is duplicated in the SCIM profile, which our RBAC normalizer treats as conflicting and returns a deny.

Impact:
- CI deploys for multiple services in us-east are failing intermittently (~15% of runs) with 403 at the auth layer.
- On-call runbooks that call the same runner are impacted; ability to perform emergency rollbacks is reduced.

Who reported: Internal DevOps team during a deploy validation window.

Observed behavior:
- Service-runner receives 200 from Okta token endpoint, but 403 on /assume-role for internal-ops API.
- Identity header shows two affiliation entries ("employee","affiliate") both present in a single claim string separated by a semicolon.
- RBAC service logs an 'ambiguous-affiliation' warning and returns policy DENY.

Expected behavior:
- RBAC normalizer should parse multiple affiliations or use precedence rules; not treat duplicate/combined attribute formats as a fatal conflict.

Additional context:
- Nightly SCIM synchronization completed at 03:02 UTC on 2026-03-10.
- We rolled a minor Okta attribute mapping change last week to add 'affiliate' as a permitted affiliation. That change was intended to write a separate array element but some identities were written as concatenated strings due to an upstream SCIM mapper bug.

Relevant links:
- Slack thread: #internal-identity (link: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01234567/p1678579201000000)
steps_to_reproduce: 2) Trigger token exchange against Okta (refresh flow) and capture ID token
3) Call internal-ops /assume-role with identity headers from token
4) Observe 403 and 'ambiguous-affiliation' warning in rbac-service logs

2026-03-10T03:05:12Z identity-sync INFO scim-sync completed entries=1243 errors=2
comments: Support (Sophie Park) 2026-03-10: Received from DevOps: scheduled deploy failures around 03:05 UTC. No infra deploys succeeded for a subset of services. Attached raw ID token and rbac logs.

SRE (Ethan Cole) 2026-03-10: Reproduced in a test pod using svc-deploy-runner. Confirmed affiliation claim is a single semicolon-delimited string. Short-term workaround: add a permissive rule in rbac-service to accept semicolon-delimited values. Will coordinate with Identity team for permanent fix.

Identity (Priya Nair) 2026-03-10: SCIM pipeline reported 2 transform errors during last run. We are investigating the mapper that emits affiliation values; suspect faulty JSON->SCIM conversion for legacy users. PR opened to normalize to array output.

SRE (Ethan Cole) 2026-03-11: Deployed temporary RBAC permissive patch to prod-us-east at 09:14 UTC to accept combined affiliation strings. CI deploy success rate returned to baseline. Monitoring in progress.

Security (Marco Ruiz) 2026-03-11: Need to confirm permissive patch does not broaden access unexpectedly. Recommend scoped patch only for svc-* system accounts while identity team fixes source mapping.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Upstream SCIM mapper emitted concatenated affiliation string for legacy accounts due to missing array wrapper; rbac normalizer lacks fallback parsing for semicolon-delimited lists.
Hypothesis 2: Recent Okta attribute mapping change added 'affiliate' but did not update SCIM transform rules for legacy identity sources, causing mixed formats.

Evidence: SCIM sync job log shows 2 transform errors; exported user 'svc-deploy-runner' raw profile: {affiliation: 'employee;affiliate'}; previous historical profile snapshots show affiliation as ['employee'] only.

Related items: linked INT-271919 (service-proxy-authz-expiry-prevents-runbook-impersonation) for prior RBAC precedence changes; identity PR #642 (internal scim-mapper) addresses normalization but needs review.
Monitoring: set up metric rbac.denies.ambiguous_affiliation and alert on >5/min in a region
resolution: Temporary: Applied a scoped permissive patch to rbac-service in prod-us-east to accept semicolon-delimited affiliation values for system accounts (svc- prefix) at 2026-03-11T09:14 UTC. Permanent: Identity team PR #642 approved to normalize SCIM affiliation output to array form; roll forward scheduled to 2026-03-12 02:00 UTC. Post-deploy: run reconciliation job to rewrite affected legacy profiles. Security will run an access audit after normalization to ensure no privilege escalation.
follow_up_tasks: 1) Identity: merge and deploy PR #642 to normalize SCIM affiliation to arrays
2) SRE: remove permissive rbac patch after reconciliation and confirm metrics remain stable
3) Identity: run one-off reconciliation job and report list of modified accounts
4) Security: perform targeted access audit for accounts modified by reconciliation
